topic: Day 50 — carousel — You build self-trust the same way you build trust with anyone else

slides.text: The same way you build trust with anyone else.
Breaking a promise to yourself erodes your own credibility.
The witness is just always you.

caption:
Breaking a promise to yourself repeatedly erodes your own credibility with yourself, just as surely as breaking promises to others erodes theirs.

Follow for one of these a day.
